0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, 4th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 2 games back) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, 1st in the Pacific and 5th in the West), and both teams are coming off a loss. Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for Toronto, while Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) is out for Los Angeles and Ziaire Williams (foot) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Raptors lost their 2025-26 season series 0-2, including a 110-93 loss in Los Angeles on 2026-01-18.
